mapper.select:
/* BoardDao.selectBoardList */ SELECT b.BOARD_NO AS board_no, b.TYPE AS board_type, b.TITLE AS title, b.WRITER_EMPNO AS writer, b.POST_DT AS post_date
ORDER BY b.POST_DT DESC, b.BOARD_NO DESC

/* BoardDao.selectBoardDetail */ SELECT b.BOARD_NO AS board_no, b.TYPE AS board_type, b.TITLE AS title, b.CONTENT AS detail, b.APPND_FILE_GROP_UUID AS append_file_group_uuid, b.POST_DT AS post_date, b.WRITER_EMPNO AS writer_emp_no, b.WRITER_EMPNO AS writer, b.VIEW_CNT AS view_count FROM AP_BOARD b WHERE b.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND b.USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: /* BoardDao.insertBoard */ INSERT INTO AP_BOARD ( TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, APPND_FILE_GROP_UUID, POST_DT, WRITER_EMPNO, USE_YN, INP_DDTM, INPR_EMPNO, INPR_IP, UPDT_DDTM, UPDTR_EMPNO, UPDTR_IP ) VALUES ( #{boardType}, #{title}, #{detail}, #{appendFileGroupUuid}, #{postDate}, #{writerEmpNo}, 'Y', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), #{userNo}, #{clientIp}, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), #{userNo}, #{clientIp} )
mapper.update: /* BoardDao.updateBoard */ UPDATE AP_BOARD SET TYPE = #{boardType}, TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{detail}, APPND_FILE_GROP_UUID = #{appendFileGroupUuid}, POST_DT = #{postDate}, WRITER_EMPNO = #{writerEmpNo}, UPDT_DDTM = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), UPDTR_EMPNO = #{userNo}, UPDTR_IP = #{clientIp} WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
